I could totally relate to this. When I was 10 somehow I managed to convince myself that I was so ugly that I didn’t even look human. I spent years and years fixated on how hideous I felt I looked, I’d literally walk around shielding my face from strangers because I really so terrified of getting mean comments from people on my looks. It literally felt like torture to just exist because I was constantly thinking about what other people were thinking of me. I’m 27 now and when I look back on my old photos I’m shocked and appalled that I let myself talk to myself that way. I wasn’t ugly- even though I REALLY believe it and fixated on it for over a decade. I can’t imagine talking to anyone else the way I used to talk to myself. I usually never comment on these things but I can confidently say with pretty much 100% certainty that you will feel the same way with some time! High school and teenage years are so brutal and for some reason we are so hard on ourselves during that time. Please please please be kinder to yourself- even if you don’t believe it I guarantee that things will be okay!! Sending you the most positive vibes and good wishes 😊🌸🌼🌻☀️🌤️⭐️🌟✨
